title: Yet another algorithmic bias: A Discursive Analysis of Large Language Models Reinforcing Dominant Discourses on Gender and Race

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative discourse analysis of LLM-generated short stories prompted to feature Black or white women, comparing the extracted Discursive Sequences (DSs) to identify distinct stereotypical and ideological narratives based on race.
Qualitative discourse analysis of the intersectional representation of women in LLM-generated text, focusing on how female characters are subjected to rigid, crystallized roles and narratives.
